title: plan_review — the box's review of ralph's Task list before the first Iteration (issue #69)
description: One fresh reviewer's verdict on the Task list, through three lenses: comprehension (the two paraphrases, written first), architecture and readiness. `plan_review_gate` reads `decision` and the findings' severities: any `error` sends the plan back to the planner for one repair turn, and the second review is recorded and never blocks. The cross-field rule (`repair` exactly when a finding has severity error) is the gate's, which counts the errors itself. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

decision.description: pass: no finding has severity error. repair: at least one does.

paraphrase.description: Written before any finding, from the issue and the Task list only.

plan.description: What the plan does, in your own words: the change, Task by Task, and how each Task hands off to the next.

system.description: How the current system works in the area the plan changes, as the issue and the code show it.

findings.description: One entry per grounded finding; [] when there is none.

severity.description: error: the plan as written would miss a criterion, cite something that does not exist, or cannot be carried out without a design decision it does not state. warning: a preference or an alternative.

requirement.description: The issue requirement or acceptance criterion the finding is about, quoted; empty when it concerns no single requirement.

message.description: What is wrong with the plan and what the planner must change.

files.description: Repository-relative paths the finding is about; may be empty but must be present.

evidence.description: What you read that shows it: a path:line, a search that found nothing, or a quote from the issue or a Task.
